title: TimS42 Advent 2025: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe

posts.author: TimS42
posts.body:
When I first got RPG Maker, I put in a resource request for some He-Man characters to which GalacticGod made me a
He-Man
walking sprite. I have been slowly churning away at my He-Man game and have decided to share some of my resources and edits. Let me know if I mess something up, I'm not to keen on using the forums. I'm also not much of an artist so any feedback, corrections or improvements are appreciated. Enjoy.
Rules:
Can use on commercial games
Must Credit TimS42 and others
Must Own MV/MZ
Can Edit (Please Share if you improve on the characters)
Repost by linking this post.
Made with LibreSprite

posts.author: GalacticGod
posts.body:
TimS42 said:
How do you guys make and post those sprite gifs with movement? I made his Tri-Clops eyes spinning using different frames in LibreSprite but don't know how to save the animation or post it.
Click to expand...
Just google, Free GIF Maker, and you should find a site that will convert it for you. You just have to cut out each frame of the animation and upload it to the maker and then save the GIF. Hope that helps.
